themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Articles discussing AI agents that can perform research tasks autonomously or semi-autonomously, including data analysis, information retrieval, and task execution.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Content focused on AI's ability to condense large amounts of text, such as meeting transcripts, research papers, or earnings calls, into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Articles detailing AI tools that assist developers with writing, debugging, and reviewing code, and the associated security implications.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Discussions about specific AI-powered tools and platforms designed to aid in various aspects of user research, data analysis, and insight generation.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Research and analysis on how AI is affecting jobs, hiring, reskilling needs, and the overall labor market.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Content exploring AI applications that directly assist in the UX design process, from idea generation and prototyping to user interface creation.

themes.name: AI sentiment & feedback analysis
themes.description: Articles focusing on how AI is used to analyze customer feedback, reviews, and sentiment to derive insights.

themes.name: AI-powered data analysis
themes.description: Content related to using AI to analyze and derive insights from research data, user behavior, and market trends.

themes.name: AI research platform
themes.description: Discussions about platforms and ecosystems that provide a suite of AI tools and capabilities for research purposes.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Articles focusing on the research, capabilities, limitations, and ethical considerations of AI-powered chatbots.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
